description: Tier-5 neighbour steps of the compound proxy (src/sim/proxy.py): per pair of neighbouring compounds, the median over calibration races of pace_frac (base_softer / base_harder - 1), wear_ratio (wear_softer / wear_harder, races with wear_harder > 0) and life_ratio (R8 limit_softer / limit_harder); sd is the sample sd across the races.
fit: full-window world fit per race, the race's default SimConfig with compound_proxy off; a compound counts when it has min_samples clean race rows

life_ratio_excluded.2025_23_qatar: mandated 25-lap maximum stint, so its tyre ages say nothing about tyre life

blend_provenance.weights: 1 / mean squared error of each source alone in the hidden-compound validation over every calibration race (fresh-pace error at mid-race for pace, wear error for wear; qualifying informs pace only)
blend_provenance.sd_floor: root mean squared error of the blend in the same validation, leave-one-race-out (the weights and the step table from the other races)

validation_provenance: forward chaining (python -m src.sim.compound_steps validate --as-of): each race priced with the step table, weights and sd floor of the races strictly before it; a policy pricing race R reads the rows of the races before R only (proxy.as_of_config)
